LIGHT.description: Small, contained, reversible change with no persistence/economy/security/release impact.
LIGHT.studio: required only when behavior or visuals need live verification

STANDARD.description: Normal gameplay, UI, content, or system work.
STANDARD.studio: required for player-visible or Studio-dependent acceptance

CRITICAL.description: Persistence, economy/monetization/RNG, networking/security, migrations, shared architecture, or release-sensitive work.
CRITICAL.studio: required when applicable; explicit human gates cannot be waived

orchestration.default_strategy: lead + Graphify repo intelligence + provider-neutral visual workflow + minimum necessary capability specialists + one fresh assurance reviewer
orchestration.parallelism: hard cap 3 active subagents; parallelize only read-only or genuinely disjoint scopes; one writer per file/system/Studio root/Blender scene area

LIGHT.notes: zero subagents is preferred when the Lead can complete safely; reviewer only when material

STANDARD.notes: normally one or two active specialists; three only for genuinely disjoint work and still never above the global cap

CRITICAL.notes: use sequential waves for additional specialist/review modes; never exceed three active subagents

orchestration.context: subagents receive compact dispatch packets, Graphify query results when useful, and only authoritative files needed for their owned scope; never the full parent chat/tool log
orchestration.human_decision_gate: required for material scope/creative fork, installs/MCPs/cost, licensing, destructive operations, migrations, Production/shared-place mutation, monetization/compliance, security/policy exceptions
orchestration.delegation_efficiency: Before spawning a subagent, ask whether Graphify/tool lookup + Lead reasoning is sufficient. Prefer one multi-mode specialist over several narrow agents.

decision_quality.dependent_material_decisions: Lead may use decision-grilling; LIGHT normally avoids multi-round interviewing
decision_quality.post_approval_change: draft revisioned scope amendment; current approved revision remains active until explicit amendment approval; pause only affected work

orchestration.usage_economy: No global TDD ritual. Prefer existing cheap deterministic checks/feedback loops; add new regression tests when task/risk requires them or they are the cheapest durable guard. Retrospectives are explicit, not automatic.
